description: This file is a PHP test class for the ClaimDao class, testing database operations related to claim events, expense types, claim requests, and related entities within the OrangeHRM claim plugin module.

classes.name: ClaimDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing ClaimDao functionalities within the OrangeHRM claim plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates ClaimDao instance, and populates test data.

methods.name: testSaveEvent
methods.description: Tests saving a new ClaimEvent and verifies its name and status.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of claim events with filters.

methods.name: testGetClaimEventById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a claim event by ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests deleting claim events by IDs.

methods.name: testCountClaimEvents
methods.description: Tests counting claim events with various filters.

methods.name: testSaveClaimRequest
methods.description: Tests saving a ClaimRequest entity with associated claim event and currency type.

methods.name: testGetNextId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the next ID for claims.

methods.name: testIsClaimEventUsed
methods.description: Tests whether a claim event is used.
